side_convention: FRONT = component side (Apple FCC 'MLB - Front'); O'Flynn 'frontside' is this project's BACK

scale.basis: photo6 BOTTOM steel rule, 93 mm ticks, linear fit resid sd 0.573 px (L1 metrology/scale-field.json)
scale.note: perspective error is NOT bounded by this; the rule lies in a different plane from the board top face

method: otsu on luma, orange-annotation mask, largest dark component, fill-holes for the outer silhouette, largest enclosed hole for the centre. NO circle is fitted to anything.

inner.note: the centre hole is a rounded square with a notch at top centre. There is no 'hole diameter'.

discarded.reason: ray crossed an orange leader arrow / watermark, or never met the boundary
